event_name: Date 06 April 2018 Time 20:08 2018 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 9) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video of the pit stop of Raikkonen at 19:14 and heard from the team representatives. The Stewards determined that the car was released in an unsafe condition in breach of Art. 28.13.b, that the team ordered the car stopped immediately, and that the driver stopped as fast as he safely could. Consistent with previous instances where a car was stopped on track, the Stewards decide that the mandatory grid place penalty could not be applied where the team took all appropriate actions, the Stewards fined the team €5,000. Gerd Ennser Paolo Longoni Danny Sullivan Mazen Al Hilli
rules_referenced: Article 28.13 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
